full_text: Board of Governors Regular Meeting Minutes #337 May 1, 2025 L.A. Care Health Plan, 1055 W. 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017. Members: Ilan Shapiro (Chairperson), John G. Raffoul (Vice Chairperson), Stephanie Booth (Treasurer), Nina Vaccaro (Secretary), Alvaro Ballesteros, Christina R. Ghaly, Layla Gonzalez, George W. Greene, Hilda Solis, G. Michael Roybal. Management: Martha Santana-Chin (CEO), Sameer Amin (CMO), Augustavia Haydel (General Counsel). WELCOME: Chairperson Ilan Shapiro called the meeting to order at 1:02 pm. APPROVAL OF MEETING AGENDA: PUBLIC COMMENT: Elizabeth Cooper raised concerns regarding the Governance Committee and representation for developmentally disabled consumers. The agenda was unanimously approved. PUBLIC COMMENTS: Elizabeth Cooper requested follow-up on previous comments. April Stom provided a heated comment regarding 'LA doesn't Care health,' citing a lack of proper neurology care and systemic failures dating back to Synermed in 2018. She mentioned filing seven complaints with the state and seeking legal counsel. APPROVE CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS: Approved unanimously. CHAIRPERSON’S REPORT: Dr. Shapiro discussed potential Medicaid funding cuts and the creation of an ad hoc committee to review strategies. CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER REPORT: Martha Santana-Chin discussed advocacy for Medi-Cal, the Los Angeles County Civil Grand Jury (CGJ) investigation into CalAIM and homelessness referrals, and the contract termination of Axminster Medical Group affecting 13,225 members. Government Affairs Update: Cherie Compartore reported a $20-$30 billion state budget deficit anticipated for 2026-2029, with a $6.2 billion deficit in the current Medi-Cal budget. Strategic Vision: Staff is working on a new strategic plan due to Medicaid impacts. L.A. Care Network Community Relief Fund Update: Shavonda Webber-Christmas reported on the $10 million wildfire response fund for Pasadena, Altadena, and the Palisades. CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER: Dr. Sameer Amin provided update on network adequacy and CalAIM.
